info.title: Inventario API
info.description: REST API for Inventario — a multi-tenant, white-label asset management platform for sports federations, municipalities, schools, and clubs. Open-source under EUPL-1.2.

bearerAuth.description: Microsoft Entra ID access token (v2.0). Multi-tenant: the JWT `tid` claim resolves the Organisation; the `oid` claim resolves the User. See apps/api/README.md for the device code flow.

get.description: Returns 200 if the API process is alive. Does not check dependencies.
Returns 200 if the API can serve requests (DB reachable).

Returns the authenticated member's own organisation, including billing and branding. The organisation id comes from the actor JWT claim, not a URL parameter — a member can only ever read their own tenant.

patch.description: Tenant admin updates their own organisation's name, contact email and billing details. plan/status/slug are NOT editable here (platform-operator only). Records an audit event with a per-field diff. Requires ADMIN role within the tenant.

text.default: Našli ste ma? Naskenujte a pomôžte ma vrátiť.

default.text: Našli ste ma? Naskenujte a pomôžte ma vrátiť.

schema.description: Tenant self-service: úprava vlastnej organizácie (názov, kontakt, billing, branding, auth doména, tlač štítkov).

requestBody.description: Tenant self-service: úprava vlastnej organizácie (názov, kontakt, billing, branding, auth doména, tlač štítkov).

post.description: Tenant admin uploads a logo image (PNG, JPEG or WEBP, max 512 KB) for their own organisation. The file is validated by magic bytes, stored in Vercel Blob, and the resulting public URL is written to brandKit.logoUrl. Any previous logo blob is deleted. Available on all plans. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of organisations sorted by displayName. Soft-deleted are excluded by default; pass `includeDeleted=true` to see them. Optional filters: status, plan. Requires ADMIN role.

post.description: Onboards a new tenant before their first SSO login. Slug + entraTenantId must both be globally unique. The alternative workflow is JIT provisioning on first contact, but explicit creation lets admins configure branding and plan upfront. Requires ADMIN role.

get.summary: Get a single organisation by ID (admin)
get.description: Returns one organisation by _id. 404 if not found or soft-deleted. Requires ADMIN role.

patch.description: Partial update — only provided fields are changed. Slug and entraTenantId are NOT updatable (stable identifiers). Custom domain uniqueness is revalidated on change. Records an audit event with a per-field diff. Requires ADMIN role.

schema.description: Čiastočná aktualizácia organizácie; všetky polia voliteľné.

requestBody.description: Čiastočná aktualizácia organizácie; všetky polia voliteľné.

delete.description: Marks the organisation as deleted. Tenant data remains in place (soft-delete is a tombstone, not a purge), but no user from this tenant can log in. Records a WARNING-severity audit event. Requires ADMIN role.

get.summary: Verejný login-context organizácie podľa slugu alebo vlastnej domény (ADR-0035)
get.description: Bez autentifikácie. Vracia len neškodné dáta (branding + povolené spôsoby prihlásenia) potrebné na to, aby /login mohol zobraziť správne tlačidlá pre danú organizáciu. Presne jeden z query parametrov (slug/domain) musí byť zadaný.

Returns the user record corresponding to the JWT bearer. Creates a new user record on first call (JIT provisioning) with the default `EMPLOYEE` role and binds it to the tenant resolved from the JWT `tid` claim. Subsequent calls return the existing record and update `lastLoginAt`.

patch.description: Self-service partial update of the authenticated user's profile. Permitted fields: `firstName`, `lastName`, `displayName`, `preferences`. Forbidden fields (roles, email, isActive, …) are excluded from this schema — include them in the body and they will be rejected with 400. If `firstName` or `lastName` is updated without an explicit `displayName`, the server auto-derives `"{firstName} {lastName}"`. Emits a USER_UPDATED audit event with a diff of changed fields.

schema.description: Self-service profile update (GDPR čl. 16); firstName, lastName, displayName, preferences.

requestBody.description: Self-service profile update (GDPR čl. 16); firstName, lastName, displayName, preferences.

get.description: Returns a structured JSON export of all personal data held for the currently authenticated user. Covers: full profile, all tenant memberships, and all audit log entries where the user is the actor. Secrets (passwordHash, mfaSecret, mfaRecoveryCodes) are always excluded. Emits a DATA_EXPORT_REQUESTED audit event (GDPR Art. 30). Any authenticated user may call this endpoint for their own data only.

Returns a paginated list of users sorted by displayName. Soft-deleted users are always excluded. Optional filters: role, isActive, q (free-text across email + displayName + firstName + lastName, case-insensitive). Requires ASSET_MANAGER or ADMIN role — but ASSET_MANAGER callers receive a trimmed shape (_id, displayName, firstName, lastName, email, roles, isActive, lastLoginAt), never the full document (MFA state, GDPR restriction flags, etc. stay ADMIN-only). See `toManagerShape` below.

get.summary: Get a single user by ID (manager)
get.description: Returns one user by _id. 404 if not found or soft-deleted. Requires ASSET_MANAGER or ADMIN role — ASSET_MANAGER callers receive the same trimmed shape as the list endpoint (see GET /v1/users above).

patch.description: Partial update of a user. Exposes `isActive`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `displayName`, and `email`. Role changes go through PATCH /v1/memberships/:id (ADR-0029). Guardrails: admins cannot deactivate themselves, the last active ADMIN cannot be deactivated (promote another user to ADMIN first), and `email` can only be changed for LOCAL accounts (400 for OAuth-linked ENTRA_ID/GOOGLE accounts) and must be unique within the organisation (400 on duplicate). Records USER_DEACTIVATED / USER_REACTIVATED / USER_UPDATED audit events. Requires ADMIN role.

schema.description: Čiastočná aktualizácia používateľa (admin); isActive, firstName, lastName, displayName, email (LOCAL účty len). Roly → PATCH /v1/memberships/:id.

requestBody.description: Čiastočná aktualizácia používateľa (admin); isActive, firstName, lastName, displayName, email (LOCAL účty len). Roly → PATCH /v1/memberships/:id.

get.description: Minimalny zoznam osob v ramci tenanta (meno, rola, e-mail, aktivita) pre modul "Osoby". Na rozdiel od GET /v1/users nevracia cely User dokument. Vyzaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN.

delete.description: Clears MFA enrollment for the target user. Use when a user has lost access to their authenticator app. The user must re-enroll on next login. Admin cannot reset their own MFA via this endpoint — use POST /v1/auth/mfa/disable. Records MFA_RESET_BY_ADMIN audit event. Requires ADMIN role.

post.summary: Set or clear processing restriction (admin, GDPR Art. 18)
post.description: Sets (`restrict: true`) or clears (`restrict: false`) the GDPR Art. 18 processing-restriction flag on a user. A restricted user's data is retained but further processing is blocked: the auth middleware rejects mutating requests (POST/PATCH/DELETE) with 403 while still allowing reads (GET). Optional `reason` is recorded for compliance. Emits USER_RESTRICTED or USER_UNRESTRICTED audit event. Idempotent calls (already in the requested state) return 400. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: Paginated list of assets (newest first). Soft-deleted excluded.

post.description: Server generuje inventoryNumber z Organisation.inventoryNumberFormat a publicToken cez CSPRNG. Tenant musi mat nastaveny inventoryNumberFormat - inak 400. Vyzaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN.

items.description: Normalizovaný tag (trim, zbalené medzery, malé písmená)

schema.description: Telo pre vytvorenie assetu; inventoryNumber a publicToken generuje server

requestBody.description: Telo pre vytvorenie assetu; inventoryNumber a publicToken generuje server

get.description: Abecedne zoradený zoznam všetkých unikátnych tagov použitých na nezmazaných majetkoch tenanta. Zdroj návrhov pre TagsCombobox.

get.summary: Tagy s počtom použití (pre číselník Tagov)
get.description: Abecedne zoradený zoznam tagov s počtom nezmazaných majetkov, ktoré daný tag používajú. Zdroj pre číselník "Tagy" na /ciselniky.

tag.description: Normalizovaný tag (trim, zbalené medzery, malé písmená)

post.summary: Premenovať tag na všetkom majetku (číselník Tagov)
post.description: Nahradí `oldTag` za `newTag` na každom nezmazanom majetku, ktorý `oldTag` má. Ak majetok už `newTag` obsahuje, duplicita sa zlúči. Zaznamená sa audit event ASSET_TAG_RENAMED. Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN rolu.

oldTag.description: Normalizovaný tag (trim, zbalené medzery, malé písmená)

newTag.description: Normalizovaný tag (trim, zbalené medzery, malé písmená)

post.summary: Zmazať tag zo všetkého majetku (číselník Tagov)
post.description: Odstráni `tag` z poľa tags na každom nezmazanom majetku, ktorý ho má. Zaznamená sa audit event ASSET_TAG_DELETED. Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN rolu.

tag.description: Normalizovaný tag (trim, zbalené medzery, malé písmená)

get.summary: Get a single asset by ID
get.description: 404 if not found or soft-deleted.

patch.description: Partial update. inventoryNumber a publicToken su nemenné.

items.description: Normalizovaný tag (trim, zbalené medzery, malé písmená)

get.summary: Rozlíš majetok podľa QR tokenu (interné, prihlásené)
get.description: Vráti id majetku pre daný publicToken v rámci tenanta aktéra. 404 ak token neexistuje alebo patrí inému tenantovi.
Záznamy auditu pre konkrétny majetok (najnovšie prvé), stránkované. Len ASSET_MANAGER/ADMIN. 404 ak majetok neexistuje v tenantovi.

On-demand QR render. URL zakodovana v QR: ${appBaseUrl}/scan/${publicToken}. Vyzaduje nastaveny appBaseUrl na Organisation - inak 409. Obrazok obsahuje aj logo organizacie v strede QR a inventoryNumber/nazov pod kodom. format=svg (default) alebo png.

Záznamy auditu pre aktívny tenant (najnovšie prvé), stránkované, s voliteľnými filtrami podľa akcie (`action`), typu entity (`entityType`), osoby (`actorUserId`) a dátumového rozsahu (`dateFrom`/`dateTo`). Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN.
Prílohy (foto, doklady) naviazané na majetok, najnovšie prvé.

post.description: Multipart upload jedného súboru (PNG/JPEG/WEBP → foto, PDF → doklad). Max 20 MB. Súbor sa uloží do Vercel Blob, metadata do DB.

patch.description: Označí ASSET_PHOTO ako hlavné foto entity; ostatné sa odznačia.

delete.description: Soft-delete metadata + odstránenie blobu z úložiska (best-effort).

get.summary: Verejny lost & found lookup po QR tokene (ADR-0021)
get.description: Bez autentifikacie. Vracia minimalne informacie o najdenom majetku. 404 ak tenant nema zapnuty publicAssetLookup ALEBO token neexistuje (no oracle).

delete.summary: Delete asset condition (ADMIN only, FK protected)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of categories, sorted by sortOrder then name. Soft-deleted categories are excluded. Optional filters: parentId, isActive.

post.description: Creates a new category. Slug must be unique. If parentId is supplied, the parent must exist. Requires ASSET_MANAGER or ADMIN role.

schema.description: Telo pre vytvorenie kategórie; slug je voliteľný (server odvodí z name).

requestBody.description: Telo pre vytvorenie kategórie; slug je voliteľný (server odvodí z name).

get.summary: Get a single category by ID
get.description: Returns one category by its _id. 404 if not found or soft-deleted.

patch.description: Partial update — only provided fields are changed. Slug uniqueness and parent existence are revalidated on change. Records an audit event with a per-field diff. Requires ASSET_MANAGER or ADMIN role.

schema.description: Čiastočná aktualizácia kategórie; všetky polia voliteľné.

requestBody.description: Čiastočná aktualizácia kategórie; všetky polia voliteľné.

delete.description: Marks a category as deleted. Refuses deletion if the category has any non-deleted child categories (would orphan them), or if any non-deleted assets reference it. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of locations, sorted by name. Soft-deleted locations are excluded. Optional filters: parentId, type, isActive.

post.description: Creates a new location. Slug must be unique (or derived from name if omitted). If parentId is supplied, the parent must exist and the resulting depth must not exceed the hierarchy limit. Requires ASSET_MANAGER or ADMIN role.

schema.description: Telo pre vytvorenie lokality; slug je voliteľný (server odvodí z name).

requestBody.description: Telo pre vytvorenie lokality; slug je voliteľný (server odvodí z name).

get.summary: Get a single location by ID
get.description: Returns one location by its _id. 404 if not found or soft-deleted.

patch.description: Partial update — only provided fields are changed. Slug uniqueness, parent existence, and hierarchy invariants (cycle, depth) are revalidated on change. Records an audit event with a per-field diff. Requires ASSET_MANAGER or ADMIN role.

schema.description: Čiastočná aktualizácia lokality; všetky polia voliteľné.

requestBody.description: Čiastočná aktualizácia lokality; všetky polia voliteľné.

delete.description: Marks a location as deleted. Refuses deletion if the location has any non-deleted child locations (would orphan them), or if any non-deleted assets reference it. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: Vráti stránkovaný zoznam žiadostí. EMPLOYEE vidí len vlastné. ASSET_MANAGER a ADMIN vidia všetky v rámci tenanta.

post.summary: Create a loan request (katalógová žiadosť, ADR-0026)
post.description: Vytvorí novú katalógovú žiadosť (kategória + množstvo). Žiadosť nerezervuje majetok — správca vydá pri fulfil. Každý EMPLOYEE môže podať žiadosť.

get.summary: Get a loan request by ID

delete.description: Zruší PENDING žiadosť. ADR-0026: nič sa neuvoľňuje (nebola rezervácia). Môže len autor žiadosti alebo ADMIN.

post.description: Schváli PENDING žiadosť (stav → APPROVED). ADR-0026: schválenie UŽ NEVYTVÁRA Loan — to sa deje pri fulfil. Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN.

Vydá majetok z APPROVED / PARTIALLY_FULFILLED žiadosti. Správca mapuje položky žiadosti na konkrétne kusy (SERIALIZED) alebo BULK množstvo. Vznikne nový Loan. Žiadosť prejde do PARTIALLY_FULFILLED / FULFILLED / CLOSED. Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN.
Zamietne PENDING žiadosť. ADR-0026: žiadna rezervácia — nič sa neuvoľňuje. Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN.

get.summary: List my active and historical loans
get.description: Returns a paginated list of loans for the currently authenticated user. Includes `isOverdue: boolean` computed field on each loan. Available to any authenticated user.

Returns a paginated list of loans. EMPLOYEE sees only their own loans. ASSET_MANAGER and ADMIN see all loans in the tenant, optionally filtered by `status`, `borrowerId`, or `assetId`. Each loan includes `isOverdue: boolean` computed field.

post.summary: Create a direct loan (without a prior request)
post.description: Creates a loan immediately, without requiring a LoanRequest. Asset goes directly AVAILABLE → BORROWED. Use for walk-in handover when the borrower is physically present. `requestId` is null on the resulting Loan. Requires ASSET_MANAGER or ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns a single loan with `isOverdue: boolean` computed field. Accessible to the borrower or any ASSET_MANAGER / ADMIN.

post.description: Processes the return of an ACTIVE loan. For each item, `requiresService: true` moves the asset to IN_SERVICE; otherwise AVAILABLE. Loan transitions to RETURNED (all ok) or DAMAGED (any requiresService). Requires ASSET_MANAGER or ADMIN role.

Marks an ACTIVE loan as LOST. All borrowed assets move to LOST status. This action is irreversible — create a new asset record if the item is eventually found and returned to service. Requires ASSET_MANAGER or ADMIN role.

get.description: Stránkovaný zoznam protokolov tenanta, najnovšie prvé. ASSET_MANAGER/ADMIN vidí všetky protokoly organizácie, EMPLOYEE len tie, kde je odovzdávajúcou alebo preberajúcou stranou. Filtrovateľné podľa `type` a `status`.

post.description: Vytvorí DRAFT protokol pre existujúcu výpožičku, ktorá ho ešte nemá — určené pre výpožičky vzniknuté pred zavedením protokolov. HANDOVER vyžaduje loan bez handoverProtocolId; RETURN vyžaduje vrátený loan bez returnProtocolId. Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN rolu.

get.description: Vráti všetky protokoly (HANDOVER + RETURN) viazané na danú výpožičku. Prístupné borrowerovi daného Loan alebo ASSET_MANAGER/ADMIN.
Vráti JSON záznam protokolu (číslo, strany, stav, podpisy). Prístupné účastníkovi protokolu (handover/receive strana) alebo ASSET_MANAGER/ADMIN.

Vyrenderuje PDF protokolu zo záznamu a vráti ho ako application/pdf. Render je deterministický — rovnaký záznam → vždy identický PDF. pdfSha256 sa dopočíta a uloží po prvom stiahnutí (lazy). Prístupné účastníkovi protokolu alebo ASSET_MANAGER/ADMIN.

post.description: Zapíše podpis prihlásená strana (handover alebo receive). Keď sú obe strany podpísané, protokol prejde DRAFT → SIGNED a pdfSha256 sa fixuje (hash záväznej podpísanej verzie). Každá strana môže podpísať len svoju rolu.

get.description: Zlúči counts (assets/categories/locations/activeLoans), zoznamy žiadostí (PENDING/APPROVED/PARTIALLY_FULFILLED), aktívne výpožičky a DRAFT protokoly do jednej odpovede. RBAC: zoznamy idú cez loansService (EMPLOYEE len vlastné), protokoly cez participantUserId pravidlo.

Vygeneruje PDF s mriežkou QR štítkov pre zvolené assety. Každý štítok obsahuje QR kód (appBaseUrl/scan/publicToken), inventoryNumber a názov. Preset avery-l7160: 3×8 = 24 štítkov/A4 (default). Preset avery-l7163: 2×7 = 14 štítkov/A4. Vyžaduje nastavený appBaseUrl na Organisation — inak 409.
Vygeneruje ZPL string pre jeden asset. Odovzdajte ho Zebra Browser Print agentovi na doručenie na termotlačiareň. Rozmery a DPI sa berú z Organisation.labelPrinting configu. format=zpl je povinný.

post.description: Vygeneruje ZPL string pre každý asset v dávke (max 200). Vracia pole { assetId, zpl } — frontend ich odovzdá Browser Print agentovi.

get.summary: Prehľad skladu — všetky BULK položky tenanta
get.description: Vráti zoznam všetkých BULK položiek tenanta s aktuálnym zostatkom a množstvom posledného príjmu (pre farebné indikátory). Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN rolu.
Vracia paginovaný zoznam pohybov pre BULK položku, zoradených od najnovšieho. Len pre položky s trackingMode === BULK.

post.description: Zaúčtuje príjem kusov na sklad. Kladné množstvo. Aktualizuje `quantityOnHand` na položke a zapíše do ledgera. Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN rolu.
Zaúčtuje ručnú korekciu skladového množstva (kladnú aj zápornú). Dôvod je povinný. Nesmie stiahnut zostatok pod nulu. Vyžaduje ASSET_MANAGER alebo ADMIN rolu.

post.summary: Reconciliation — overenie konzistencie cache vs ledger
post.description: Overí že `asset.quantityOnHand` (cache) súhlasí so `sum(stock_movements.quantity)` (zdroj pravdy). Ak nie, opraví cache. Diagnostická operácia — vyžaduje ADMIN rolu.

tags.name: Organisations
tags.description: Tenant lifecycle management. Each Organisation is a tenant boundary; all other resources are scoped to exactly one Organisation.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User accounts and current-user lookup. JIT-provisioned on first login via Microsoft Entra ID. Tenant-scoped per Organisation.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Physical asset inventory — devices, equipment, vehicles, supplies.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Hierarchical asset categorisation per tenant. Slugs are unique within an Organisation.

tags.name: Locations
tags.description: Hierarchical physical location tree per tenant. Slugs are unique within an Organisation.
